meta.name: jacobrakai-honeypot-blocklist
meta.description: Honeypot-confirmed attacker IPs observed against live decoy services (SSH, FTP, telnet, MySQL, VNC): credential-tier entries submitted login credentials repeatedly; scanner-tier entries probed at abusive volume without ever submitting credentials; loader-tier entries delivered a payload into a honeypot session.
meta.inclusion_criteria: three tiers, all requiring real attack activity within the last 30 days: 'credential' = honeypot-confirmed repeated credential-attack attempts (50+); 'scanner' = sustained credential-less abuse, 1000+ connection/probe events in-window; 'loader' = delivered a payload (fetched or uploaded a file inside a honeypot session) in-window, no volume floor
meta.field_notes: tier: 'credential', 'scanner' or 'loader'. For credential-tier entries, attempts = lifetime credential attempts and bans = ban cycles; for scanner- and loader-tier entries, attempts = connection events inside the current window and bans is always 0 — ban cycles for those tiers are tracked outside the credential ban pipeline and are not counted in this field. first_seen and last_seen both describe observed attack activity inside the current window, so first_seen <= last_seen always holds. first_banned is bookkeeping — when this IP was first firewalled — and may fall outside the window or after last_seen; it is null for scanner- and loader-tier entries.
meta.disclaimer: Provided as-is, no warranty. Entries may involve dynamic or reassigned IPs; verify before acting. Contact the maintainer for delisting.
